courses.name: Class 8 Foundation (CBSE)
courses.eligibility: Students currently in Class 7 or entering Class 8
courses.description: Comprehensive foundation program for Class 8 CBSE students. Builds strong conceptual understanding in Maths and Science while developing language and social studies skills aligned with the latest NCERT curriculum.
courses.test_frequency: Weekly chapter tests + Monthly full-length tests

courses.name: Class 8 Foundation (ICSE)
courses.eligibility: Students currently in Class 7 or entering Class 8 (ICSE)
courses.description: Rigorous ICSE-aligned foundation program for Class 8. ICSE's depth in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology is handled with separate subject-specific modules. Strong emphasis on written expression and analytical thinking.

courses.name: Class 9 Foundation (CBSE)
courses.description: Class 9 is where the real academic challenge begins. This program covers Class 9 CBSE syllabus in depth — Algebra, Coordinate Geometry, Chemical Reactions, Motion, Heredity, and more — while simultaneously laying the groundwork for Class 10 boards.

courses.name: Class 9 Foundation (ICSE)
courses.description: Intensive ICSE Class 9 program. ICSE has 8+ subjects which are individually handled. Detailed attention to Physics, Chemistry, Biology separately — preparing students for ICSE's rigorous written exams and also subtly building competitive exam awareness.
courses.study_material: Apex ICSE modules + Council prescribed textbooks

courses.name: Class 10 Board Excellence (CBSE)
courses.description: Board-focused intensive program for Class 10 CBSE. Special emphasis on CBSE exam patterns, marking schemes, and answer writing techniques. Covers entire syllabus by January for 3 months of dedicated revision and mock boards.
courses.study_material: Apex Board Excellence modules + CBSE Sample Papers
courses.test_frequency: Weekly tests + 5 Full Mock Board exams

courses.name: Class 10 Board Excellence (ICSE)
courses.description: Comprehensive ICSE Class 10 board preparation. ICSE board exams are known for their depth. This program ensures thorough coverage of all subjects with answer-writing workshops, past paper analysis (10 years), and dedicated teachers for each subject.
courses.study_material: Apex ICSE Board Excellence modules + ISC/ICSE past papers
courses.test_frequency: Subject-specific weekly tests + 6 Full Mock Board exams

courses.name: JEE Mains Preparation (2-Year)
courses.eligibility: Students entering Class 11 or current Class 11 students
courses.description: Two-year comprehensive JEE Mains preparation program. Builds deep conceptual foundation in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics from Class 11 base topics through to full JEE Mains syllabus. Includes 2-year test series with performance tracking.
courses.study_material: Apex JEE proprietary modules (PCM) — 6 volumes per subject
courses.test_frequency: Chapter tests weekly + Monthly JEE Mains mock + Annual All-India Mock

courses.name: JEE Advanced Intensive (1-Year)
courses.eligibility: Students in Class 12 or who have completed Class 12, targeting IIT
courses.description: One-year high-intensity program targeting JEE Advanced. Assumes strong fundamentals. Focuses on JEE Advanced level problem solving — multi-concept questions, integer-type, paragraph questions. Designed for students aiming for top IIT seats.
courses.study_material: Apex Advanced Problem Bank (500+ JEE Advanced level problems per subject)
courses.test_frequency: Twice-weekly tests + Monthly JEE Advanced mock (3-hour paper pattern)

courses.name: JEE Dropper Batch
courses.eligibility: Students who appeared for JEE in the previous year and are repeating
courses.description: Specialized dropper program for JEE aspirants. Starts with a diagnostic test to identify weak areas. Personalized study plan combining targeted revision with new problem-solving strategies. Focus on mental resilience and time management.
courses.study_material: Apex Dropper Revision Kit + fresh problem sets for weak topics
reference_books: Comprehensive coverage across HC Verma, Arihant, and NCERT
courses.test_frequency: 3 tests per week (alternate subjects) + Fortnightly full JEE mock

courses.name: NEET 2-Year Foundation
courses.eligibility: Students entering Class 11 who want to pursue MBBS / BDS
courses.description: Comprehensive two-year NEET preparation starting from Class 11. NCERT-first approach — all Biology is taught chapter-by-chapter as per NCERT since NEET questions are directly from NCERT text. Physics and Chemistry taught conceptually with NEET-specific question patterns.
courses.study_material: Apex NEET modules (NCERT-aligned) + Biology diagram handouts
courses.test_frequency: Weekly subject tests + Fortnightly NEET pattern test + Monthly full NEET mock

courses.name: NEET 1-Year Intensive
courses.eligibility: Students in Class 12 targeting NEET this year
courses.description: One-year intensive NEET program covering full Class 11 + Class 12 syllabus. Paced to complete theory by January for 4 months of revision and mock tests. NCERT Biology done line-by-line with assertion-reason and match-the-column practice.
courses.study_material: Apex 1-Year NEET modules + NEET PYQ bank (10 years)
courses.test_frequency: Alternate-day subject tests + Weekly NEET mock (200 MCQ pattern)

courses.name: NEET Repeater Crash Course
courses.eligibility: Students who appeared for NEET previously and are retaking
courses.description: Focused crash course for NEET repeaters. Diagnostic test on Day 1 to identify weak chapters. Rapid revision of all chapters with special focus on high-weightage NCERT Biology paragraphs. Includes 15 full-length NEET mock tests for exam conditioning.
courses.study_material: Apex Repeater Revision Kit + High-yield Biology flashcards
courses.test_frequency: 3 full NEET mocks per week in final 2 months
